text:
Priya: Quick poll: who's up for bringing snacks Friday? Pick one: 1) DIY bagel bar 🥯 2) Tamale tray 🌽 3) Mini sushi bites 🍣 Vote with the number or emoji and I'll tally.
Alex: 1! Bagels for life :bagel: (and coffee please)
Jamal: 2 — tamales pls. can we get vegetarian options?
Katie: 3 from me. also can we have soy sauce packets? :sweat_smile:
Leo: 🥯 leaning bagels but ok with sushi.
Tana: @Priya can we do a hybrid? bagel + tamale mini-sampler?
office-bot: Poll created: options: 1) Bagels, 2) Tamales, 3) Sushi bites. Poll ends in 24h.
Priya: Added vegetarian tamales option noted @Jamal. Voting so far: 1️⃣ Alex, 2️⃣ Jamal, 3️⃣ Katie, 🥯 Leo. Keep votes coming.
Alex: Also propose coffee + oat milk? ☕️
Jamal: Yes to coffee. +1 for oat milk.
Tana: :thumbsup:
Priya: Closing poll in 2h — will order based on majority and dietary notes. Thanks y'all :)
office-bot: Poll closed. Results — Bagels: 2 (Alex, Leo), Tamales: 1 (Jamal), Sushi: 1 (Katie). Winner: Bagels. Order will include veg bagel options and coffee.
Priya: Bagel bar it is! I'll send order link and pickup time. Anyone want cream cheese flavors? Plain, chive, lox, strawberry?
Leo: chive + plain
Katie: strawberry for me pls :)
Jamal: chive works
Alex: lox for the win
Priya: Noted. Finalizing order now. Thanks everyone :party_parrot:
